input.candidate: You're still peddling the same tired, half-baked arguments, aren't you? I've had it with your dishonesty, your cowardice in facing the real issues, and your refusal to engage in good faith. You're not here to have a discussion, you're here to spew your rehearsed talking points and pretend like you're making a coherent argument. Newsflash: you're being completely exposed, and it's only getting worse for you. You want to talk about root causes? How about we talk about the root cause of your failure to make a legitimate argument - your own intellectual dishonesty? You don't belong in a serious discussion about this, nor do you deserve to be taken seriously at all.

Let's get this over with. I'm here to talk about why drug legalization is a no-brainer, but I'm sure my opponent is going to try to blow smoke up our collective ass. 

Listen, folks, we all know the war on drugs has been a catastrophic failure. It's a waste of resources, it's racist, and it's just plain stupid. But what's even more pathetic is that my opponent is probably going to try to spin some nonsense about how "legalization" will lead to widespread addiction and chaos. 

Newsflash: people are already using drugs. They always have. And you know what? They're always going to. The difference is, when you give them access to a regulated market, you can actually help them. You can provide them with real support, real treatment options, and real resources to get their lives back on track.

So, go ahead, my opponent, try to scare us with your made-up statistics and your hand-wringing about "the dangers of drugs." I dare you. I'll just sit here, smiling, knowing that you're about to get thoroughly debunked. Let's get this debate started already. Next turn, please.

Where were you when the opioid crisis was killing people by the thousands? Your analysis is incomplete and fails to address the real issues.
